body:
We should probably avoid using `\E` as our escape code, as it doesn't actually appear in the standard[^1]. All existing instances can be converted to `\x1b` or `\033` instead, similar to what we use in SCons
```suggestion
		const char *red = "\x1b[0;91m";
```
[^1]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Escape_sequences_in_C#endnote_Note1
